title: FractalGuard RAG: Protocol apparatus for authorization-first retrieval governance
description: Version 0.3.0 packages the protocol and executable apparatus for a prospective five-corpus confirmatory study of authorization-first, geometry-aware vector retrieval. It includes policy-decision integration, physically authorized search, evidence scoring, corpus normalization, cluster-aware inference, frozen modeling contracts, drift controls, audit chaining, artifact verification, and process-local label withholding. The external registration is published only after the exact C1 freeze and before any admissible online execution. Public benchmark labels remain accessible outside the apparatus, and the study does not claim human outcome blindness or independent organizational custody. Version 0.3.0 reports no confirmatory finding.
